subject: Expansion: Launching additional teams — launchpad plan & API key map
messages:
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@fleetworks.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-09-18T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Expansion: Launching additional teams — launchpad plan & API key map

Hi Elena,

Great to speak yesterday — thanks for the time. Per our chat, FleetWorks is ready to extend the pilot into three additional product teams (Search, Billing, and Notifications). Attached is a concise "launchpad" plan that maps out:

- per-team API key needs and namespaces
- recommended capacity (qps & token budgets) for the first 90 days
- a phased schedule for provisioning and integration windows

Action items I suggest this week:
1) Review the attached launchpad (spreadsheet) and confirm the three team owners
2) Procurement: let us know the billing/PO contact so we can send the addendum
3) Security: if you need an SOC2 attestation or specific ingress restrictions, flag them now so we can include them in the deployment runbook

I've attached FleetWorks_Launchpad_v1.xlsx and will follow up with a short kickoff agenda once we have owners. We can also provision test API keys into your sandbox by Wednesday if you approve.

Thanks — L

--
Lauren Bishop
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0147

Attachments: fleetworks_launchpad_v1.xlsx
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@fleetworks.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Cc: it-ops@fleetworks.com, procurement@fleetworks.com
Date: 2025-09-18T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: Launching additional teams — launchpad plan & API key map

Thanks Lauren — got the spreadsheet and skimmed it. A couple quick clarifications before we loop procurement/security in: 

- For Billing team: will the Billing calls be routed to a single shared key, or should we provision a per-service key (they prefer per-service for audit)?
- For Notifications: expected peak qps listed looks high; can we start smaller and scale?
- Procurement: procurement@fleetworks.com is the right contact. They will request an addendum and standard net-30 terms.
- Security: our security lead (cc'd IT) will request SOC2 Type II and an IP allowlist for any production keys.

Can you put together a short timeline (2–3 bullets) for provisioning + contract steps so I can present it to the group on Monday?

Best,
Elena
VP Product, FleetWorks

On Thu, Sep 18, 2025 at 08:12 AM lauren.bishop@redwood.ai wrote:
> Hi Elena,
> 
> Great to speak yesterday — thanks for the time. Per our chat, FleetWorks is ready to extend the pilot into three additional product teams...
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-09-19T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: Launching additional teams — launchpad plan & API key map

Quick internal alignment after Elena's questions: 

- Recommendation: Provision per-team keys (one key per service/team) to satisfy audit and reduce blast radius. We'll also supply a consolidated billing identifier to keep invoicing simple.
- Capacity: Start with conservative quotas: Billing 30 qps, Notifications 15 qps, Search 60 qps — autoscale allowed once we confirm latencies. We'll document token budgets per endpoint.
- Contract/terms: Procurement is asking net-30. We can sign an addendum that keeps the existing SOW intact but adds the 3-team extension + a 20% committed discount on baseline monthly throughput. Legal can prepare a short addendum (1 page).

Next steps for us:
1) Lauren: send the procurement contact the draft addendum and HubSpot deal link.
2) Priyom: please confirm committed throughput tiers for the discount and the start date you want on the addendum.
3) Monica: coordinate SOC2 attestation and provide the standard security packet (we'll include the IP allowlist template).

I'll be on the kickoff call if needed.

- Ben

--
Ben Carter
Director of Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@fleetworks.com>, FleetWorks Procurement <procurement@fleetworks.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai, it-ops@fleetworks.com, monica.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2025-09-19T13:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: Launching additional teams — launchpad plan & API key map

Elena / procurement team — thanks for the quick reply. Below is a condensed timeline you can bring to Monday's meeting: 

1) Contract addendum & terms (Net-30): draft shared by Redwood by EOD 9/19, procurement review 9/20–9/21, expected signature by 9/24. (DocuSign link will be provided).
2) Security packet & SOC2 attestation: Redwood security packet shared 9/19; SOC2 Type II summary available upon request — security can schedule a call 9/22 if needed.
3) Sandbox keys provisioned: Redwood will create test API keys for each named team by 9/24 for integration testing.
4) Production cutover: tentative 10/06 — includes IP allowlist, traffic ramp to agreed quotas, and a 2-week performance check.

Notes on Billing vs. keys: we recommend per-service keys for Billing to satisfy auditability. We'll also include a consolidated billing tag so invoices remain simple. 

Attached: redwood_term_addendum_draft.pdf, api_key_dispatch_template.csv
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/FW-2025-019
DocuSign (will be live after internal legal sign-off): https://www.docusign.com/templates/fw-expansion-addendum

Please confirm that timeline works and whether procurement prefers the addendum to include explicit committed tokens/month (we can add a short table if that helps).

Thanks — Lauren

Attachments: redwood_term_addendum_draft.pdf, api_key_dispatch_template.csv
From: FleetWorks Procurement <procurement@fleetworks.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, Elena Torres <elena.torres@fleetworks.com>
Cc: it-ops@fleetworks.com
Date: 2025-09-20T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: Launching additional teams — launchpad plan & API key map

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for the timeline. A few procurement/security items before we sign: 

- Terms: FleetWorks standard is net-30; please confirm those payment terms are included in the addendum.
- SOC2: please provide the SOC2 Type II report summary and the contact for Redwood Security (we'll need to schedule a quick intake call).
- Insurance & PO: we will issue a PO once the addendum is signed. Please advise invoice routing and remit-to.
- IP allowlist: IT requests the exact IP ranges you will use for production egress.

If you can provide the above by EOD 9/21, we can keep to the signing target of 9/24.

Regards,
Pat Nguyen
FleetWorks Procurement
procurement@fleetworks.com

4) Owner: Priyom will be primary on delivery and will own the provisioning runbook; Monica will own the security intake.

I'll send the addendum through DocuSign once legal confirms the discount table (Ben/Priyom please confirm by EOD 9/23).

Thanks — L
